questions.skill: Use geometric shapes to model real objects
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 9 as a second forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: A tree trunk is modeled as a cylinder with a diameter of 2 feet and a height of 30 feet. Estimate its volume in terms of π. Then give one reason the model might overestimate or underestimate the real volume.
questions.prompt_markup:
A tree trunk is modeled as a cylinder with a diameter of 2 feet and a height of 30 feet.
Estimate its volume in terms of π. Then give one reason the model might overestimate or underestimate the real volume.
questions.correct_answer: 30π cubic feet; for example, a real trunk gets narrower toward the top, so the model may overestimate.
questions.grading_note: Grade both: 30π cubic feet, and any reasonable way the real trunk differs from a cylinder.
